Visit a local Sheriff to learn more.lations on becoming a citizen! Citizens gain benefits like discounts, boons, and exclusive rewards.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "5096C064461F6250B249789C1F39E337", "To fund those benefits, citizens pay taxes in the form of Tax Vouchers. These are earned by doing actions that benefit the Settlement.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "76271D99425CE7BB51434C8EF7AFBA93", "Commissions, buy orders, and voting in mayoral elections are just a few of the ways you can contribute. Get out there and do your part!")
